### Load data

```{r}
load(paste0(file.path, "Data/patient.data.RData"))
```

### Sensitivity Analysis: Sepsis-free Survival

X-hour time window for patients with the outcome
Negative patients: full hospitalization
Positive patients: only those predictions X hours before sepsis onset
```{r}
patient.data.Xh <- patient.data |> 
  group_by(LCSN) |> 
  filter(sep3.outcome==0 | (sep3.outcome==1 & time.point >= max.time.point - time_horizon*4))
```

Aggregate data
```{r}
aggregated.data <- aggregate(patient.data.Xh, list(patient.data.Xh$LCSN), max)
```


```{r}
final.thresholds <- c(20, 25, 30)

subgroups <- c(
  "All",
  "Male",
  "Female",
  "Tufts",
  "Melrose",
  "Lowell",
  paste("Younger than", young.age, "years"),
  paste("Between", young.age, "and", old.age, "years"),
  paste("Older than", old.age, "years"),
  "White",
  "Asian",
  "Black",
  "Other"
)

total.iterations <- length(final.thresholds) * length(subgroups)
iteration <- 0

results.list <- vector(
  "list",
  length = total.iterations
)

result.i <- 1

# Progress bar
pb <- txtProgressBar(
  min = 0,
  max = total.iterations,
  style = 3
)

for (final.threshold in final.thresholds) {

  for (subgroup in subgroups) {

    # -----------------------------
    # Select subgroup
    # -----------------------------

    if (subgroup == "All") {

      data.subgroup <- aggregated.data

    } else if (subgroup %in% c("Male", "Female")) {

      data.subgroup <- aggregated.data |>
        filter(sex == subgroup)

    } else if (subgroup %in% c("Tufts", "Melrose", "Lowell")) {

      data.subgroup <- aggregated.data |>
        filter(center.grouped == subgroup)

    } else if (
      subgroup %in% c(
        paste("Younger than", young.age, "years"),
        paste("Between", young.age, "and", old.age, "years"),
        paste("Older than", old.age, "years")
      )
    ) {

      data.subgroup <- aggregated.data |>
        filter(age.groups == subgroup)

    } else if (
      subgroup %in% c(
        "White",
        "Asian",
        "Black",
        "Other",
        "Unknown"
      )
    ) {

      data.subgroup <- aggregated.data |>
        filter(race.groups == subgroup)

    } else {

      data.subgroup <- aggregated.data[0, ]
    }

    # -----------------------------
    # Remove missing model scores
    # and create binary prediction
    # -----------------------------

    data.subgroup <- data.subgroup |>
      filter(
        !is.na(model.score)
      ) |>
      mutate(
        binary.prediction = as.numeric(
          model.score > final.threshold / 100
        )
      )

    # -----------------------------
    # Sample size
    # -----------------------------

    n <- nrow(data.subgroup)

    lcsn.values <- unique(data.subgroup$LCSN)

    LCSN_n <- length(lcsn.values)

    events <- sum(
      data.subgroup$sep3.outcome == 1,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )

    # -----------------------------
    # Initialize AUC results
    # -----------------------------

    auc.value <- NA_real_
    auc.lower <- NA_real_
    auc.upper <- NA_real_

    # -----------------------------
    # Check whether AUC can be
    # calculated
    # -----------------------------

    valid.auc <- (
      n > 0 &&
      LCSN_n > 1 &&
      length(unique(
        na.omit(data.subgroup$sep3.outcome)
      )) == 2 &&
      length(unique(
        na.omit(data.subgroup$binary.prediction)
      )) == 2
    )

    # -----------------------------
    # Calculate AUC and 95% CI
    # -----------------------------

    if (valid.auc) {

      roc.object <- pROC::roc(
        response = data.subgroup$sep3.outcome,
        predictor = data.subgroup$binary.prediction,
        direction = "<",
        quiet = TRUE
      )

      # AUC
      auc.value <- as.numeric(
        pROC::auc(roc.object)
      )

      # 95% confidence interval
      auc.ci <- pROC::ci.auc(
        roc.object,
        conf.level = 0.95
      )

      # Lower 95% CI
      auc.lower <- as.numeric(
        auc.ci[1]
      )

      # Upper 95% CI
      auc.upper <- as.numeric(
        auc.ci[3]
      )
    }

    # -----------------------------
    # Store results
    # -----------------------------

    results.list[[result.i]] <- data.frame(
      threshold = final.threshold,
      subgroup = subgroup,
      n = n,
      LCSN_n = LCSN_n,
      events = events,
      AUC = auc.value,
      AUC_lower_95CI = auc.lower,
      AUC_upper_95CI = auc.upper,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )

    # -----------------------------
    # Update progress bar
    # -----------------------------

    result.i <- result.i + 1

    iteration <- iteration + 1

    setTxtProgressBar(
      pb,
      iteration
    )
  }
}

close(pb)

# -----------------------------
# Combine all results
# -----------------------------

auc.results <- bind_rows(
  results.list
)

# View results
auc.results
```

```{r}
auc.table <- auc.results |>
  mutate(
    threshold = paste0("AUC_", threshold),
    AUC_formatted = sprintf(
      "%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)",
      AUC,
      AUC_lower_95CI,
      AUC_upper_95CI
    )
  ) |>
  select(subgroup, threshold, AUC_formatted) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = threshold,
    values_from = AUC_formatted
  )

auc.table
```

```{r}
openxlsx::write.xlsx(
  auc.table,
  file = paste0(
    file.path,
    "Binarized AUCs/Binarized AUC by Subgroup - Time Horizon ",
    time_horizon,
    ".xlsx"
  ),
  rowNames = FALSE
)
```
